items.headline: McDaniels: Rematch with Seahawks will be different for Pats
items.description: Josh McDaniels didn't mince words when asked what he learned from how the Seahawks terrorized quarterback Drake Maye in Super Bowl LX in February. "I didn't do a good enough job. Point it at me," he said.
